verses.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
verses.pt: Na verdade, há minas donde se extrai a prata, e também lugar onde se refina o ouro:
verses.en_web: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.
verses.en_bbe: Truly there is a mine for silver, and a place where gold is washed out.

verses.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.pt: O ferro tira-se da terra, e da pedra se funde o cobre.
verses.en_web: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.
verses.en_bbe: Iron is taken out of the earth, and stone is changed into brass by the fire.

verses.en: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.pt: Os homens põem termo às trevas, e até os últimos confins exploram as pedras na escuridão e nas trevas mais densas.
verses.en_web: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.
verses.en_bbe: Man puts an end to the dark, searching out to the farthest limit the stones of the deep places of the dark.

verses.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.pt: Abrem um poço de mina longe do lugar onde habitam; são esquecidos pelos viajantes, ficando pendentes longe dos homens, e oscilam de um lado para o outro.
verses.en_web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
verses.en_bbe: He makes a deep mine far away from those living in the light of day; when they go about on the earth, they have no knowledge of those who are under them, who are hanging far from men, twisting from side to side on a cord.

verses.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.pt: Quanto à terra, dela procede o pão, mas por baixo é revolvida como por fogo.
verses.en_web: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.
verses.en_bbe: As for the earth, bread comes out of it; but under its face it is turned up as if by fire.

verses.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.pt: As suas pedras são o lugar de safiras, e têm pó de ouro.
verses.en_web: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.
verses.en_bbe: Its stones are the place of sapphires, and it has dust of gold.

verses.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
verses.pt: A ave de rapina não conhece essa vereda, e não a viram os olhos do falcão.
verses.en_web: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.
verses.en_bbe: No bird has knowledge of it, and the hawk's eye has never seen it.

verses.en: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.pt: Nunca a pisaram feras altivas, nem o feroz leão passou por ela.
verses.en_web: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.
verses.en_bbe: The great beasts have not gone over it, and the cruel lion has not taken that way.

verses.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.pt: O homem estende a mão contra a pederneira, e revolve os montes desde as suas raízes.
verses.en_web: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.
verses.en_bbe: Man puts out his hand on the hard rock, overturning mountains by the roots.

verses.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.pt: Corta canais nas pedras, e os seus olhos descobrem todas as coisas preciosas.
verses.en_web: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.
verses.en_bbe: He makes deep ways, cut through the rock, and his eye sees everything of value.

verses.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.pt: Ele tapa os veios d'água para que não gotejem; e tira para a luz o que estava escondido.
verses.en_web: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.
verses.en_bbe: He keeps back the streams from flowing, and makes the secret things come out into the light.

verses.en: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.pt: Mas onde se achará a sabedoria? E onde está o lugar do entendimento?
verses.en_web: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.en_bbe: But where may wisdom be seen? and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

verses.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.pt: O homem não lhe conhece o caminho; nem se acha ela na terra dos viventes.
verses.en_web: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.en_bbe: Man has not seen the way to it, and it is not in the land of the living.

verses.en: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
verses.pt: O abismo diz: Não está em mim; e o mar diz: Ela não está comigo.
verses.en_web: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’
verses.en_bbe: The deep waters say, It is not in me: and the sea says, It is not with me.

verses.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.pt: Não pode ser comprada com ouro fino, nem a peso de prata se trocará.
verses.en_web: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.
verses.en_bbe: Gold may not be given for it, or a weight of silver in payment for it.

verses.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.pt: Nem se pode avaliar em ouro fino de Ofir, nem em pedras preciosas de berilo, ou safira.
verses.en_web: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.en_bbe: It may not be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the onyx of great price, or the sapphire.

verses.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
verses.pt: Com ela não se pode comparar o ouro ou o vidro; nem se trocara por jóias de ouro fino.
verses.en_web: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.
verses.en_bbe: Gold and glass are not equal to it in price, and it may not be exchanged for jewels of the best gold.

verses.en: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.pt: Não se fará menção de coral nem de cristal; porque a aquisição da sabedoria é melhor que a das pérolas.
verses.en_web: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.en_bbe: There is no need to say anything about coral or crystal; and the value of wisdom is greater than that of pearls.

verses.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.pt: Não se lhe igualará o topázio da Etiópia, nem se pode comprar por ouro puro.
verses.en_web: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.en_bbe: The topaz of Ethiopia is not equal to it, and it may not be valued with the best gold.

verses.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.pt: Donde, pois, vem a sabedoria? Onde está o lugar do entendimento?
verses.en_web: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?
verses.en_bbe: From where then does wisdom come, and where is the resting-place of knowledge?

verses.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.pt: Está encoberta aos olhos de todo vivente, e oculta às aves do céu.
verses.en_web: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.
verses.en_bbe: For it is kept secret from the eyes of all living, unseen by the birds of the air.

verses.en: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.pt: O Abadom e a morte dizem: Ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos um rumor dela.
verses.en_web: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
verses.en_bbe: Destruction and Death say, We have only had word of it with our ears.

verses.en: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.pt: Deus entende o seu caminho, e ele sabe o seu lugar.
verses.en_web: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.
verses.en_bbe: God has knowledge of the way to it, and of its resting-place;

verses.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.pt: Porque ele perscruta até as extremidades da terra, sim, ele vê tudo o que há debaixo do céu.
verses.en_web: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.
verses.en_bbe: For his eyes go to the ends of the earth, and he sees everything under heaven.

verses.en: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.pt: Quando regulou o peso do vento, e fixou a medida das águas;
verses.en_web: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.
verses.en_bbe: When he made a weight for the wind, measuring out the waters;

verses.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.pt: quando prescreveu leis para a chuva e caminho para o relâmpago dos trovões;
verses.en_web: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;
verses.en_bbe: When he made a law for the rain, and a way for the thunder-flames;

verses.en: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.pt: então viu a sabedoria e a manifestou; estabeleceu-a, e também a esquadrinhou.
verses.en_web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
verses.en_bbe: Then he saw it, and put it on record; he gave it its fixed form, searching it out completely.

verses.en: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.pt: E disse ao homem: Eis que o temor do Senhor é a sabedoria, e o apartar-se do mal é o entendimento.
verses.en_web: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to man, Truly the fear of the Lord is wisdom, and to keep from evil is the way to knowledge.
